title: Explicit finite-sum Cech sorting and contraction operators
statement: Let X be a scheme, I a linearly ordered type, U : I -> Opens(X) any family, F an abelian-group presheaf, and S a SiteCechComplex for U over the terminal open [def-pc-scheme, def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. For a tuple t, stable permutations sigma order the pairs (t(k),k) lexicographically. Partial permutations tau_a agree with sigma before a and list the unused original positions increasingly after that. Define kappa_p by summing sign(sigma) times pullback of the t composed sigma coordinate over stable permutations. Define P_p by the same sum over permutations for which t composed sigma is strictly increasing. Define H_p on a (p+1)-cochain by summing (-1)^a sign(tau_a) times the coordinate on the junction tuple (t(sigma(0)),...,t(sigma(a)),t(tau_a(a)),...,t(tau_a(p))), transported by S.indexMap, over sigma,a,tau_a satisfying these finite filters. Define K_p by summing sign(sigma)(-1)^a times the coordinate on the sorted tuple with its first repeated entry at position a duplicated, again transported by S.indexMap. All sums range over finite permutations and positions; no unproved existence theorem supplies data. Extend H_p and K_p by equality transport to adjacent pairs i=j+1, as the families cechFirstSortingFamily and cechSecondSortingFamily.
